translation_notes: Context shim semantic_objects_context.py: SH (namespaces.py), naming.py, ir.py (verbatim) and shacl.py lines 1-241 (everything above the region: _literal_str, _literal_int, _dump_subgraph, _iter_alternations, _parse_pin, _parse_nested_pins, _parse_value_shape, _parse_or_members, _or_property_shape, _parse_alternation_property_shape, _ALTERNATION_PREDICATES), verbatim from lazlop/semantic_objects@243c5efd8c; the package is not installed. Those helpers stay plain rdflib on both sides: only the region is translated.

Existence reads: `(bn, SH.sparql, None) in g` -> `bool(m{ {bn} sh:sparql ?o })`; `any((bn, pred, None) in g for pred in _ALTERNATION_PREDICATES)` -> `any(m{ {bn} {pred} ?o } for pred in _ALTERNATION_PREDICATES)` (predicate interpolated in predicate position; the predicates are a tuple of values, so the loop stays Python).

Value reads: the six `g.value(x, P)` -> `m{ {x} sh:P ?o }.first()` (g.value defaults to any=True, no error on several values, hence .first() and not .one()); `{p for p, _ in g.predicate_objects(qvs)}` -> `{p for p, _ in m{ {qvs} ?p ?o }}` (twice). The three `_literal_*` calls and `_dump_subgraph` stay: project helpers. `SH.node in extra_preds` etc. -> `sh:node in extra_preds`, `{SH['class']}` -> `{sh:class}`.

`from ..namespaces import SH` is replaced by `@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .` in the block: the project module is plain Python, so `from … import sh:` (which imports prefixes declared by another ldpy module) does not apply.

Driver: 26 calls, one per branch of the function (inverse-path, sparql, sh:or / sh:xone Union, unclean alternation, forbidden, direct class/datatype, qualified with pins / supplementary notes / Union, nested-node, other) plus neighbours: look-alike predicates in another namespace (ex:or, ex:sparql), a sibling property shape carrying sh:sparql and sh:or, and another node with the same predicates. Compared as dataclasses, including raw_turtle. Mutants killed: free subject on sparql / alternation / datatype reads, sh:or only, .one() instead of .first(), no `- {sh:class}`, free qvs subject.
